raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

On ROCm, `_supports_native_decode` is `next_n in (1, 2)`, so MTP with 2+ speculative tokens is flattened to one row per draft token and each row re-reads its sequence's KV. The AITER paged kernels have no such limit. This adds `VLLM_ROCM_INDEXER_NATIVE_DECODE_MAX_NEXT_N` (default 2, today's behaviour) to raise the cap.

**Needs #59420** above `next_n = 2` (otherwise `Memory access fault` in warm-up).

## Test Plan

GLM-5.3, TP4, MI355X, `deepseek_mtp`, cap = 8, Gluon decode, #59420 applied, CUDA graphs on. Throughput sweep, GPQA Diamond, RULER niah_single_2 (64k).

## Test Result

| next_n (spec tokens) | GPQA | NIAH | Geomean tok/s/GPU |
|---|---|---|---|
| no MTP | 0.879 | 1.00 | 2435.5 |
| 3 (2) | 0.889 | 1.00 | 3309.1 |
| 5 (4) | 0.904 | 1.00 | 3607.8 |

Throughput per GPU:

| Conc | 8k/1k no MTP | 8k/1k n=3 | 8k/1k n=5 | 60k/600 no MTP | 60k/600 n=3 | 60k/600 n=5 |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4 | 544.4 | 1105.3 | 1337.0 | 2925.1 | 4067.3 | 4422.3 |
| 8 | 897.5 | 1650.6 | 2015.3 | 3889.2 | 4658.8 | 4408.6 |
| 16 | 1415.4 | 2177.6 | 2648.5 | 4550.6 | 4948.6 | 5050.4 |
| 32 | 2058.7 | 3061.8 | 3638.4 | 4938.2 | 5175.0 | 5303.4 |
| 64 | 2853.3 | 4013.9 | 4447.8 | | | |
| 128 | 3741.3 | 4715.5 | 4291.3 | | | |
| 256 | 4603.2 | 4663.6 | 5208.6 | | | |

The no-MTP run is the same setup without speculative decoding (decode paged MQA logits on the FlyDSL kernel instead of Gluon).
